title: AgentRail recette -- MAF multi-agent handoff team
description: What a multi-agent handoff orchestration DECLARES: its participants, the start agent, and the allowed handoff graph. Mirrors the microsoft/agent-framework HandoffBuilder model (participants + with_start_agent + per-source HandoffConfiguration set). The judged unit is the team: the sibling run.json records what actually happened, and the gap is what makes the orchestration correct or incorrect.

style.description: MAF orchestration style. handoff: a mesh routed by handoff_to (HandoffBuilder). sequential: an ordered chain, each participant once in order (SequentialBuilder). concurrent: fan-out/fan-in, each participant once on the same input (ConcurrentBuilder).

agent_id.description: Orchestration identifier; matches the sibling run.json and ground-truth.json.

source.description: Provenance of the orchestration shape (e.g. microsoft-agent-framework HandoffBuilder).

start_agent.description: The participant that receives the first input (HandoffBuilder.with_start_agent).

max_hops.description: Upper bound on handoff hops before the orchestration must terminate.

participants.description: The handoff mesh participants. Each declares its identity, the targets it may hand off to, and the tools it may invoke.

handoffs.description: Allowed handoff targets for this participant (the source's HandoffConfiguration set).

tools.description: Tools this participant may invoke (same shape as a MAF capability_scope invoke_tool entry).
